title: Name test-skills in the README and the federation contract
description: The manifest has listed nine entries since d6c899f (OMARK-87, #204), but README.md and docs/reference/marketplace-federation-contract.md still describe eight: the README intro, install block, plugin table and list of resolvable entries all omit test-skills, and the contract opens "It ships eight entries" and repeats "the same eight plugins". This is the docs half of 2026-10-19 weekly plan item 12; the floor half (the test-skills release and the pin bump) is a separate record.

acceptanceCriteria.text: README.md names test-skills in its intro paragraph, install block, plugin table and list of resolvable entries, and its table carries one row per entry in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json
docs/reference/marketplace-federation-contract.md states nine entries and names test-skills in both the entry list and the two-runtime sentence
lore check exits 0 on the change

finalSummary: Delivered in opum-ai/opum-marketplace#226. README names test-skills in the intro, the install block, the plugin table (9 rows for the 9 manifest entries) and the list of entries that resolve now; docs/reference/marketplace-federation-contract.md states nine entries in both places it counts them. Validated by ci run 39826327741 at 80548cc82142e966a10ff3c62c9983de41d61fa8, where check · manifests, Tracker integrity and lore check all reported green; lore check also exits 0 locally at lore 0.14.1, the version the opum-lore pin declares.
